messages:
maria: Customer 'BrightApps' seeing 429s on /v1/generate (org 3412) starting ~2026-03-17T09:10Z. Console rate panel shows 0 throttles for that org. Ticket INC-4521. Screenshot uploaded https://redwood.app/incident/INC-4521 :frowning:

aj: @maria can you paste the raw curl + X-Request-ID? Which region?

maria: region us-west-2. Raw response (redacted):
```
curl -i -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{...}'
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
X-Request-ID: 01F8G5abcd
Retry-After: 30
```

david: quick check from telemetry — enforcement service returning 429s for org 3412 between 09:09:22 and 09:12:00, but the metrics ingestion to Console's rate panel hasn't processed events since 08:55. Running a query now: 
```
SELECT count(*) FROM enforcement_log WHERE org_id=3412 AND ts BETWEEN '2026-03-17 09:00' AND '2026-03-17 09:15';
-- returns 84
```
So enforcement is doing the blocking; dashboard is missing those events (ingestion gap).

ops-bot: [ALERT] rate-enforcement-429 spike (prod, us-west-2) — 80 events in 10m — triggered 2026-03-17T09:13:00Z :rotating_light:

sarah: we deployed metrics-forwarder v2.4.0 2026-03-16 22:30 UTC which changed Kafka batching. I see a consumer lag bump at ~08:50 this morning, probable root.

aj: telemetry — can you confirm consumer offsets / lag? If forwarder is lagging dashboards will show zero despite enforcement running.

david: offsets: consumer group `metrics-forwarder-consumer` shows lag ~1.2M messages on partition 4. Consumer crashed and restarted and is throttled on single thread. Opened CI job #CI-899 to restart with increased parallelism and force a rebalance.

kevin: hotfix in progress — scaled metrics-forwarder replicas from 2 -> 6 and bumped consumer parallelism. Kicked the consumer and started backfill job. Watching backfill throughput.

maria: customer notified that we're investigating; they still see intermittent 429s. I've added their request-id to the ticket.

sarah: after backfill begins we should see events appear in Console and the rate panel should reflect the enforcement spikes. Follow-ups: add an alert for consumer lag >100k and a runbook to S3-backfill enforcement logs for urgent repros.

aj: action items: (1) telemetry complete backfill and confirm dashboard events for org 3412, (2) ops keep scaling if lag doesn't drop, (3) support keep customer informed.

maria: noted. I'll update INC-4521 and ping when resolved. :thumbsup:
